# Oliver Neal

> Gameplay programmer specialising in Unity and C#, based in Middlesbrough, North East England. Making games in Unity since 2018, building them consistently since 2023. First Class BSc (Hons) Games Development graduate from Teesside University (July 2026, 80% overall). Winner of Best Games Programming and Development Artefact at ExpoTees 2026. Currently a gameplay programmer at Shiverbug Studios, and available from September 2026.

Strongest in the systems layer of games: component-driven state machines for players and enemy AI, simulation and tick architecture, multiplayer netcode, and the profiling and optimisation work that keeps a scene inside its frame budget. Nine shipped projects, seven built solo, most of them playable on itch.io with source on GitHub.

Tools and workflow: Git and Git LFS, branch workflow on a shared team repo, Visual Studio, JetBrains Rider, Figma, Trello, technical documentation.

Contact: oliverjn04@gmail.com

## Current role

- Gameplay Programmer (intern) at [Shiverbug Studios](https://shiverbugstudios.com/), 13 July to 18 September 2026, ten weeks. Working in Unity 6 on Out of Water, an original IP: a two-player splitscreen 3D platformer collectathon. Owns character and enemy gameplay code, the co-op moveset, performance work (GPU-driven rendering, quality tiers, LOD and culling, measured with a profiling tool built for the team), splitscreen device routing and cameras, a UI Toolkit front end, a decoupled FMOD audio layer, editor tooling for level designers, and water/caustic/bubble shaders in Shader Graph and hand-written URP HLSL.
- Studio team page: https://shiverbugstudios.com/team/oliver-neal.html

## Project breakdowns

Deep technical write-ups of how each game actually works.

- [Cyber Station](https://oliverneal.dev/cyber-station.html) (Unity 3D, C#, solo, April 2026): neon station management game and final-year project. Placement and construction, a central fixed 10 Hz passenger simulation that routes by lowest estimated total delay (queue wait plus real NavMesh walk time), coordinated staff AI, and a six-factor station rating system. 86 scripts, ~17,000 lines. Scored 90/100 as an artefact and won Best Games Programming and Development Artefact at ExpoTees 2026. Play in the browser, or download for Windows: https://olivernealdev.itch.io/cyber-station Source: https://github.com/OliverNealDev/CyberStation
- [Tile Turfer](https://oliverneal.dev/tile-turfer.html) (Unity 2D, C#, solo, January 2026): Splatoon-style turf-war shooter. Procedural cave generation, runtime 2D NavMesh baking, and a single territory percentage that drives difficulty, fire rate and enemy AI together. Play: https://olivernealdev.itch.io/tile-turfer — source: https://github.com/OliverNealDev/TileTurfer
- [Minimalists](https://oliverneal.dev/minimalists.html) (Unity 3D, C#, solo, August 2025): node-conquest RTS pared back to essentials, where forces are committed by percentage against enemy AI that scales from duels to four-way free-for-alls. Play: https://olivernealdev.itch.io/minimalists — source: https://github.com/OliverNealDev/Minimalists
- [Wanted](https://oliverneal.dev/wanted.html) (Unity 6, C#, solo, May 2025): top-down stealth survival game built in one week for the Tyne to Game jam. No win condition, only a survival timer. A single detection meter fills at 1.0/s in the open and 0.25/s under foliage, decays only after a 3 second grace, and on a confirmed sighting redirects the closest 10% of officers. Three-state officer AI (patrol, chase, search last known position) on a runtime-baked 2D NavMesh via NavMeshPlus, an escalating force of six patrol cars and twenty-four officers plus helicopter passes and radars, 250 procedurally placed trees with distance-culled 2D shadows. MIT licensed. Play: https://olivernealdev.itch.io/wanted — source: https://github.com/OliverNealDev/Wanted
- [Unicellular](https://oliverneal.dev/unicellular.html) (Unity, C#, solo, February 2025): idle simulation holding thousands of FSM-driven organisms in one scene via a decoupled multi-rate tick and time-sliced proximity AI, stress-tested at 1,000 and 10,000 entities. Play: https://olivernealdev.itch.io/unicellular — source: https://github.com/EmbitGames/UnicellularRebuiltECS
- [3D Netcode Tank Game](https://oliverneal.dev/tank-game.html) (Unity 3D, C#, solo, January 2025): server-authoritative multiplayer tank shooter on Unity Netcode for GameObjects, with a 64-ray hitscan resolved on the server, a decoupled turret aiming rig, Relay-hosted sessions and cloud authentication. Source: https://github.com/OliverNealDev/NetcodeTankGame
- [Pinnable](https://oliverneal.dev/pinnable.html) (Unity 2D, C#, solo, March 2024): arcade score-attack catch game with a weighted spawn director, homing and drilling pin behaviours and a physics-driven catch loop. Play: https://olivernealdev.itch.io/pinnable — source: https://github.com/OliverNealDev/Pinnable
- [Space Bar Simulator](https://oliverneal.dev/space-bar.html) (Unreal Engine 5, Blueprints, team of ten, January 2026): retro-futurist first-person bar simulator. Oliver's contribution: the player controller on Enhanced Input, a component-based interaction system behind a Blueprint interface, camera-blended interactive stations and the UI computer terminal.

## Other projects

- Candy Corporate (team, April 2024): 2D top-down extraction game inspired by Lethal Company. Oliver's contribution: level design, tile creation and pixel art integration. Play: https://jurgenwithwings.itch.io/candycorporate
